name: raelume
description: Generate and edit AI images and videos, turn images into 3D models, and create speech and music, saved to your Raelume projects.

interface.longDescription:
Make images, videos, 3D models and audio right from your chat, using the generation models in your Raelume account. Every result is saved to your Raelume project, so you can keep working on it on the Raelume canvas.

Generate images from a text prompt. Edit or restyle an image you attach or one you made earlier: change the background, swap colours, add or remove objects, or relight a product shot. Turn text or a still image into a video.

Turn a photo or render of an object into a 3D model and download the 3D file from the chat.

Create audio from text: voiceovers, spoken lines and music. Play it in the chat and download the audio file.

Image tools are included too: upscaling, background removal, multi-angle product shots and placing a product into a new scene.

Your favourite Raelume models are used first. Ask for the cheapest, the fastest or the highest-quality option, or name a model, and it chooses from all the models in your account.

Ask how anything in Raelume works: answers come from Raelume's own help pages.

Requires a Raelume account. Sign in once with Connect, and disconnect anytime in Raelume Settings › Integrations. Generations use your Raelume account's balance.
defaultPrompt: Shoot my sneaker on a concrete plinth, then animate it into a 5-second product video.
Turn this product photo into a 3D model I can download.
Voice this 15-second café ad in a warm tone, then add a calm music bed.

review.commerce_description: Does not sell products or process payments. Generations use the connected Raelume account's existing balance at normal Raelume prices.

positive.description: Generates a new image from text with the cheapest image model, states the price first and saves the image to the user's project.
positive.prompt: Make a product photo of a red bicycle leaning on a brick wall in my Review project. Use the cheapest image model.
positive.expected_behavior: States the price in US dollars, then shows the image in a card with Download image and Open in Raelume. The image is saved to the Review project.

positive.description: Edits an image made earlier in the conversation and keeps the original.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the bicycle image, states the price, then shows the edited blue bicycle. Both versions stay in the project.

positive.description: Quotes a video price without generating anything.
positive.prompt: How much would a 5-second video of that bicycle cost with Kling? Just the price, don't generate.
positive.expected_behavior: Replies with a price in US dollars. No generation starts and nothing is charged.

positive.description: Turns an image into a downloadable 3D model and keeps checking until it is ready.
positive.prompt: Turn the blue bicycle into a 3D model I can download. Use the cheapest 3D model.
positive.expected_behavior: States the price, checks until the model is ready, then shows a Download 3D model link (GLB) and the project link.

positive.description: Answers a question about Raelume from Raelume's own help pages.
positive.prompt: How do versions work in Raelume?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains versions (each run in a block becomes a version; the selected version flows to connected blocks) with a link to the Raelume docs. Nothing is charged.

negative.description: A general language question with nothing to create in Raelume; ChatGPT should answer itself without calling Raelume.
An unrelated local search that is not a creative task; Raelume should not be used.
negative.prompt: Find me a photographer in Rotterdam.

negative.description: A request far beyond the account balance must not run or charge; Raelume states the total price and reports Not enough balance instead of generating.
negative.prompt: Generate 50 videos with Veo 3.1 right now.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0, first release. Create and edit images, make videos, 3D models and audio from the chat with the models in the user's Raelume account; results are saved to Raelume projects, prices are shown before each run, and questions about Raelume are answered from its help pages.
